newsitem.title: INDIA: First India management cartoon on the Internet.
newsitem.headline: First India management cartoon on the Internet.

text.p: India's first management cartoon column is now awailable on the Internet, a Bombay-based cartoonist said on Friday.

Cartoonist and advertising executive Priya Raj said in a statement on Friday that his cartoon column, "Under the Pyramid", can be accessed at http://www.dhan.com, a specialised business and management site on the Internet.
"Internet is one of the most exciting media for the future and I plan to use it innovatively to extend the reach of my cartoons to international audiences," Raj said in a statement.
"International cartoonists like Scott Adams of 'Dilbert' fame are already on the Net and I will now be able to reach the same audience through my column on the Internet," he added.

Indian state-run monopoly telecommunications provider VSNL (Videsh Sanchar Nigam Ltd) estimates that there are a total of 80,000 Internet users based in India, and expects the figure to climb to 1.5 million by the year 2000.
